items.title: 清华大学王智：工业大模型「数据、算力、成本」三重门，我们如何系统破局？丨GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 2025年12月12-13日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳·博林天瑞喜来登酒店正式启幕。 作为AI 产学研投界的标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守“传承+创新”内核，始终致力于连接技术前沿与产业实践。 在人工智能逐步成为国家竞争核心变量的当下，算力正以前所未有的速度重塑技术路径与产业结构。13日举办的「AI 算力新十年」专场聚焦智能体系的底层核心——算力，从架构演进、生态构建到产业化落地展开系统讨论，试图为未来十年的中国AI产业，厘清关键变量与发展方向。 GAIR 2025「AI 算力新十年」专场上，清华大学深圳国际研究生院副教授王智发表了题为《工业机理 × 大模型：行业大模型的系统约束与可控推理的研究进展》的主题演讲，系统阐述了他对工业大模型训推和落地实践的核心判断。 当智能制造从自动化走向智能化，工业大模型被视为关键一跃，却也直面着真实产线中数据稀缺、算力受限、成本敏感的三重挑战。这不仅是一个算法问题，更是一个需要贯通学术前沿与产业实践的复杂系统工程。 在此背景下，清华大学深圳国际研究院的王智教授与其联合团队，选择了一条“从场景中来，到场景中去”的攻坚路径。他们依托国家基金委重点项目，联合深圳信息职业技术学院、汇川技术等合作伙伴，在过去一年里，将研究扎根于工业质检、具身智能、程序生成等具体场景，试图拆解并回应那些最实际的问题：如何用大模型升级传统规则系统？如何让机器自主理解并执行任务？如何在弱算力、弱网络的工厂环境下，让智能模型真正“跑起来”？ 与单纯追求模型规模的常见叙事不同，王智教授团队的工作呈现出鲜明的“工程思维”与“成本意识”。他们的探索从底层的数据生成与表征优化出发，延伸至模型规划、分布式训练与推理加速的全链路，其目标并非打造一个万能的“工业GPT”，而是构建一套能让大模型技术适配工业严苛约束、实现低成本高效部署的方法论体系。 这

excerpt_i18n.en: In recent years, as artificial intelligence has gradually moved out of laboratories and into the real world, the issue of perception has returned to the center of technical discussions. From autonomous driving and smart devices to spatial intelligence and embodied intelligence, systems are no longer just about understanding information but must continuously acquire reliable signals in complex, dynamic physical environments. In practical applications, reliance on vision-only perception has increasingly exposed limitations, prompting both academia and industry to reconsider the role of multimodal perception in the next generation of intelligent systems. Against this backdrop, wireless sensing technologies such as acoustic waves and millimeter waves have gained attention. These technologies do not aim to see but rather enable devices to understand environments and behaviors by modeling and analyzing physical signals, without adding extra burden or interfering with users. While still far from widespread adoption, they are seen as a crucial foundation for supporting spatial intelligence and real-world interaction. During GAIR 2025, Associate Professor Zhang Jin from Southern University of Science and Technology shared insights on wireless sensing, multimodal perception, and new sensing technologies for spatial intelligence. With long-term experience in related research, she focuses more on the feasibility and reliability of these technologies in real-world scenarios, rather than just their performance under experimental conditions. At the conference, AI Tech Review engaged in a dialogue with Professor Zhang Jin about wireless sensing and its applications in the real world. In the conversation, rather than offering broad judgments on the technology's prospects, she preferred to discuss the limitations and challenges faced by sensing technologies during implementation, drawing from research practice, and shared her own remarkable personal experiences.

items.title: Pixlio – Browser-based AI image editing tools
items.raw_excerpt: I'm the builder behind Pixlio. Pixlio is a browser-based AI image editor and generator for common tasks like background replacement and photo effects. I built it because I kept needing repeatable image edits for various cases. I wanted a workflow that doesn't require users to be good at prompt writing, since many tools mostly provide a prompt field. Pixlio is built with Astro and runs on Cloudflare Workers. There's a one-click signup and a small amount of free credits so you can try the core flows quickly. Image processing has real per-request costs, so it can't be unlimited free - paid credits cover heavier usage. I'd love feedback on (1) the editor workflow and (2) what kind of image tools would be most useful next.

items.title: 摩尔线程王华：万卡训练中，最危险的往往是「不报错」｜GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 作者｜包永刚 编辑｜林觉民 2025年12月12-13日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳·博林天瑞喜来登酒店正式启幕。 作为AI 产学研投界的标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守“传承+创新”内核，始终致力于连接技术前沿与产业实践。 在人工智能逐步成为国家竞争核心变量的当下，算力正以前所未有的速度重塑技术路径与产业结构。13日举办的「AI 算力新十年」专场聚焦智能体系的底层核心——算力，从架构演进、生态构建到产业化落地展开系统讨论，试图为未来十年的中国AI产业，厘清关键变量与发展方向。 王华在「AI算力新十年」论坛发表了主题为《基于国产GPU集群的大规模训练实践》的演讲。 当海外头部公司已经建设十万卡、甚至二十万卡规模的 GPU 集群，万卡训练正在从“前沿探索”转变为大模型研发的基础设施能力。模型参数规模进入万亿级之后，真正拉开差距的，已不再只是单卡性能，而是训练周期能否被压缩、系统是否长期稳定、工程效率能否支撑高频迭代。 在这样的背景下，万卡训练所面临的挑战也发生了根本变化。 节点故障、性能抖动、通信与存储瓶颈，在集群规模被放大之后都会成为常态问题，很多在千卡规模下可以容忍的风险，在万卡场景中都会被大幅放大。 王华在演讲中将结合摩尔线程在国产 GPU 万卡级真实集群上的训练实践，系统拆解这一过程中遇到的关键难题，以及相应的工程解法。从并行策略选择、训练前的模拟与起飞检查，到异步 Checkpoint、慢节点治理，再到静默数据错误、Hang 以及 Inf/NaN 等稳定性问题的应对， 他重点分享如何通过软件栈、自动化与可观测体系，把万卡训练从“能跑”推进到“可持续稳定地跑”。 这些经验并非实验室结论，而是来自真实生产环境中反复验证后的工程积累，他希望摩尔线程的经验能够给想要做万卡训练的公司和机构一些借鉴。 以下是王华演讲的精彩内容，雷峰网作了不改变

Author: Bao Yonggang  Editor: Lin Juemin  
On December 12–13, 2025, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced at the Sheraton Shenzhen Boao Tianrui Hotel.  
As a benchmark event in the AI industry-academia-research-investment ecosystem, GAIR has consistently adhered to the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016, dedicated to bridging cutting-edge technology with industrial practice.  
As artificial intelligence increasingly becomes a core variable in national competition, computing power is reshaping technological pathways and industrial structures at an unprecedented pace. The "AI Computing Power: The Next Decade" session held on the 13th focused on computing power—the foundational core of intelligent systems—engaging in systematic discussions from architectural evolution and ecosystem development to industrial implementation, aiming to clarify key variables and development directions for China’s AI industry in the coming decade.  
Wang Hua delivered a speech titled "Large-Scale Training Practices Based on Domestic GPU Clusters" at the "AI Computing Power: The Next Decade" forum.  
While leading overseas companies have already established GPU clusters on the scale of 100,000 or even 200,000 cards, 10,000-card training is transitioning from "frontier exploration" to a fundamental infrastructure capability for large model development. As model parameters reach the trillion-level, the true differentiators are no longer just single-card performance, but whether training cycles can be compressed, systems can remain stable long-term, and engineering efficiency can support high-frequency iteration.  
Against this backdrop, the challenges of 10,000-card training have fundamentally shifted.  
Node failures, performance fluctuations, and communication and storage bottlenecks become routine issues as cluster scales expand, many of which were negligible or manageable at the thousand-card level.

When working on my projects and talking to investors, I often hear:
“Just post it on Hacker News or Reddit and show that people love it.” What I find strange is that Hacker News feels oddly opaque. I’ve never met anyone who can clearly explain how it works in practice. Not just the rules, but the dynamics: what’s repeatable, what’s luck, and what actually matters. By using the Kevin Bacon-number idea: I can usually get within three degrees of separation of well-known technologists like Linus Torvalds, but I can’t seem to get within three steps of someone who confidently understands how HN works. So I’m asking sincerely:
Does anyone here feel they understand Hacker News?

excerpt_i18n.en: Based on the current trend of accelerating across all sectors, the integration of AI into the health of ordinary people will be faster than expected, said AI researcher Li Min. Recently, Wu Jingyi, a post-00s village doctor from Tushan Village in Jiujiang, Jiangxi, unexpectedly gained popularity online. People were not only moved by her story of taking over her grandfather's role as a village doctor and staying in the countryside, but also surprised by her innovative approach of using a mobile AI app to establish health records for over 200 elderly villagers and analyze their blood pressure and pulse. Behind the viral attention to this small story is the fact that young people are beginning to use new technologies to improve the lives of the elderly. It suddenly became apparent that AI applications in the health sector have already reached the most grassroots villages. The mobile app used by Wu Jingyi is called "Ant Ah Fu," an AI health management application developed by Ant Group. Launched six months ago, it has surpassed 15 million monthly active users and answers over 5 million health-related questions from users daily. The development of the AI health track goes even further. In mid-year, in Shanghai, a hub for medical excellence, the top-tier Ruijin Hospital suddenly announced a collaboration with Huawei to open-source a pathology large model. 01 Major companies are entering the field, giving rise to an "AI Ah Fu" in the health track. The "first half" of AI development focused on the intelligence limits of general large models, while entering the "second half," the deep cultivation of scenarios and practical application effectiveness in vertical tracks such as law, finance, and healthcare are becoming the real deciding factors. According to Leifeng.com, since the beginning of this year, companies including overseas giants like OpenAI and Google, as well as domestic players like Ant Group, Huawei, and Baichuan, have been rushing into the field.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según la tendencia actual de aceleración en todos los sectores, la integración de la IA en el ámbito de la salud de las personas comunes será más rápida de lo previsto, afirmó la investigadora de IA Li Min. Recientemente, Wu Jingyi, una médica rural nacida después del año 2000 de la aldea Tushan en Jiujiang, Jiangxi, se volvió inesperadamente popular en internet. Además de conmoverse por su historia de heredar el legado de su abuelo como médico rural y quedarse en el campo, la gente se sorprendió por su innovador método de usar la IA en su teléfono móvil para crear archivos de salud para más de 200 ancianos de la aldea, analizando su presión arterial y pulso. Detrás de este pequeño incidente que se hizo viral, está el hecho de que los jóvenes están comenzando a utilizar nuevas tecnologías para mejorar la vida de los ancianos. De repente, todos se dieron cuenta de que la aplicación de la IA en el campo de la salud ya se ha integrado en los niveles más básicos.

items.raw_excerpt: 2025年12月17日，香港——在全球图形学领域备受瞩目的顶级学术盛会 SIGGRAPH Asia 2025上，摩尔线程在3D Gaussian Splatting Reconstruction Challenge（3DGS 重建挑战赛）中凭借自研技术LiteGS出色的算法实力和软硬件协同优化能力，斩获大赛银奖，再次证明摩尔线程在新一代图形渲染技术上的深度积累与学术界的高度认可。   3DGS：下一代图形渲染的范式革命，开启AI加速的高效渲染时代 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS，三维高斯溅射）是2023年提出的一项革命性3D 场景表示与渲染技术，以可参数化的3D 高斯分布为核心，实现了画质、效率与资源占用之间的卓越平衡。与传统 NeRF 相比，3DGS 在保持逼真渲染质量的前提下，将渲染效率提升数百至上千倍，并在光线追踪、VR/AR 实时渲染、多模态融合等方向展现出极强的适应性与扩展性。 （*上图仅作示意）  作为近年来快速发展的神经渲染技术，3DGS不仅在三维重建与实时渲染等方向展现出卓越优势，也在更广泛的 AI 场景中具备潜在的基础价值。尤其是在具身智能（Embodied AI）等需要智能体理解并与真实环境交互的前沿领域，高质量、低延迟的三维环境建模至关重要。3DGS 以其高保真场景显示、快速优化能力和轻量级结构，为构建准确的世界模型提供了可靠支撑，有助于提升路径规划、环境感知和复杂操作任务的能力。随着 AI 技术向“理解并操作真实世界”方向不断延展，3DGS 正逐渐成为具身智能训练场景中的关键基础技术之一。 正因其对未来图形学技术路线的关键意义，3DGS 已成为全球学术界与产业界

items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网消息，2025年12月12-13日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳·博林天瑞喜来登酒店正式启幕。 作为AI 产学研投界的标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守“传承+创新”内核，始终致力于连接技术前沿与产业实践。 在人工智能逐步成为国家竞争核心变量的当下，算力正以前所未有的速度重塑技术路径与产业结构。13日举办的「AI 算力新十年」专场聚焦智能体系的底层核心——算力，从架构演进、生态构建到产业化落地展开系统讨论，试图为未来十年的中国AI产业，厘清关键变量与发展方向。 面对国产算力基础设施和大模型发展的机遇和挑战，刘方明教授作了题为《国产算力驱动的大模型体系化挑战：全生命周期工具链与示范应用》的主题报告。 当AI算力竞争进入“深水区”，国家实验室正成为国产自主可控的“压舱石”，打造“超智数融合体系结构”算力集群与全栈国产化模型工具链。 刘方明教授介绍，以鹏城实验室等科研机构为代表的“国家队”，核心使命是筑牢国产AI自主可控的底线，不与企业争利、不与高校争名，专注于国产生态“不敢做、不能做、不愿做”的“苦活累活”，即便在不依赖海外算力硬件的情况下，也能实现从算力、模型到数据处理和工具的全流程自主研发。 鹏城云脑Ⅱ等核心算力基础设施，在IO500榜单多次斩获世界冠军，而且即将落成的云脑Ⅲ采用新一代全国产化设计，将通过“超智数融合”实现超算与智算及大数据处理的协同突破。 在模型与生态构建上，鹏城实验室坚持“全生命周期国产化”，继推出大尺寸200B模型、以及对标GPT-4 Turbo的33B中等尺寸模型之后，也在Hugging Face发布了全流程开源的 2B“鹏城・脑海 2.1”小尺寸版本模型 ，公开训练数据、清洗和配比工具以及模型权重和技术报告等核心“秘诀”助力开源生态发展。 这些技术已在实战中开展验证：例如十五运期间，基于超智数融合体系结构的人工智

excerpt_i18n.en: According to Leiphone, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced at the Sheraton Shenzhen Bo'Lin Tianrui Hotel on December 12-13, 2025. As a benchmark event in the AI industry-academia-research-investment sector, GAIR has consistently adhered to the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016, dedicated to bridging cutting-edge technology with industrial practice. As artificial intelligence increasingly becomes a core variable in national competition, computing power is reshaping technological pathways and industrial structures at an unprecedented pace. The "AI Computing Power in the Next Decade" session held on the 13th focused on computing power—the foundational core of intelligent systems—engaging in systematic discussions from architectural evolution and ecosystem development to industrial implementation, aiming to clarify key variables and development directions for China's AI industry over the next decade. Addressing the opportunities and challenges in domestic computing power infrastructure and large-scale model development, Professor Liu Fangming delivered a keynote report titled "Systemic Challenges of Domestic Computing Power-Driven Large Models: Full-Lifecycle Toolchains and Demonstration Applications." As AI computing power competition enters the "deep-water zone," national laboratories are becoming the "ballast" for domestically controlled, self-reliant systems, developing computing power clusters with "hyper-intelligent data fusion architecture" and fully localized model toolchains. Professor Liu Fangming noted that "national team" institutions, represented by research bodies like Peng Cheng Laboratory, have the core mission of securing the baseline for domestically controlled AI, avoiding competition with enterprises for profit or with universities for prestige, and focusing on the "hard and heavy tasks" within the domestic ecosystem that others "dare not, cannot, or are unwilling to undertake." This ensures that even without reliance on overseas computing power hardware, achievements can be made from computing...
excerpt_i18n.es: Según informa Leifeng, los días 12 y 13 de diciembre de 2025, se inauguró oficialmente la octava edición de la Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica (GAIR) en el Sheraton Shenzhen Boao Tianrui Hotel. Como evento de referencia en el ámbito de la investigación, educación, industria e inversión en IA, GAIR, desde su creación en 2016, ha mantenido su esencia de "herencia + innovación" y se ha dedicado a conectar la vanguardia tecnológica con la práctica industrial. En un momento en que la inteligencia artificial se está convirtiendo gradualmente en una variable central en la competencia entre naciones, la potencia de cálculo está remodelando las rutas tecnológicas y las estructuras industriales a una velocidad sin precedentes. La sesión especial "La Nueva Década de la Potencia de Cálculo en IA", celebrada el día 13, se centró en la potencia de cálculo, núcleo fundamental de los sistemas inteligentes, abordando sistemáticamente desde la evolución de la arquitectura y la construcción del ecosistema hasta su implementación industrial.
